title_original: Watch The Film Stage’s Holiday Spectacular Featuring Special Guests on December 4

blocks.text: Kick off the holiday season with The Film Stage’s Holiday Spectacular, streaming live on Friday, December 4 at 3pm EST on The Film Stage’s YouTube channel ! Featuring co-founder and The B-Side host Dan Mecca and special guests Stephen Sajdak and Andrew Jupin of We Hate Movies , this special live event brings together holiday trivia, Cinephile games, and more, all in support of Astoria Food Pantry and Will Rogers Motion Picture Pioneers Foundation .

links.text: Will Rogers Motion Picture Pioneers Foundation

blocks.text: Viewers will enjoy interactive games like Christmas movie trivia, Cinephile Game rounds, and a head-to-head We Pitch You a Merry Christmas challenge where teams play the brand-new game and pitch custom holiday film concepts to the audience.

links.text: We Pitch You a Merry Christmas

blocks.text: Throughout the show, live chat participants can play along to win exciting prizes. Tune in as we celebrate the season and crown our trivia winner!
Don’t miss out by subscribing to The Film Stage’s YouTube and podcast channels!
